rules.name: Te Aupouri Smokestone
rules.description:
One use only. Duration: One Phase.
May be activated when a friendly unit fails a Break Test (after any rerolls): enemy units within 18" of the bearer have their Charge Range, Pursuit Distance, and Overrun Distance rolls Minimised.

rules.name: Stampede Resonator Crystal
rules.description:
One use only. Duration: End of Turn.
May be activated at the start of any Charge Phase. Select a single friendly unit containing models with Height 4-5 within 18": all model parts with Height 4-5 in the selected unit lose Stomp Attack and gains Impact Hits (X), where X is equal to the amount of hits from its Stomp Attack (if a model part already had Impact Hits, increase the number of hits by its amount of Stomp Attack instead).

sharedRules.name: Combat Legend
sharedRules.description:
The model gains Exclusive (Caiman Elders). 
 The Caiman Mentor model part gains Weapon Master, and Tooth and Claw, Halberd, Great Weapon. 
 While the Caiman Mentor model part is using a Melee Weapon without a Weapon Enchantment, add the following rules to the weapon, depending on the weapon used: 
 • Great Weapon: +2 Att, +1 to wound. 
 • Halberd: +2 Att, Distracting (1). 
 • Tooth and Claw: +3 Att.

sharedRules.name: Corrosive Spitter
sharedRules.description:
One use only. Choose one of the effects below to apply, with Duration: End of Turn.
All models in the unit must choose and activate the same effect simultaneously. 
 • May be activated during Combat Choices. 
The model gains Grind Attack (1, Str 2, AP 3, Unmodifiable); if it is in the second rank and not in contact with any enemy model, it can make its Grind Attack across models in the first rank directly in front of it. 
 • May be activated in the Shooting Phase. The model gains the following Shooting Weapon: 
 NameAimRangeShotsStrAPAttack AttributesCorrosive Spit16"223Accurate, March and Shoot

sharedRules.name: Hunt Leader
sharedRules.description:
The model becomes an Attachable Model, gains Exclusive (Raptor Pack, Raptor Riders), and loses Solitary. 
While the model is joined to a unit of Raptor Pack or Raptor Riders, the model gains Pack Hunter. 
Model parts with Magnasaur in the model’s unit gain Fury. 
No more than a single model with Hunt Leader can ever be joined to the same unit.

sharedRules.name: Communal Bond
sharedRules.description:
Courage and Command Tests taken by the model’s unit are Minimised, and may use the Discipline from other units within 8", following the rules below: 
 • Choose a single model in the unit to take the test for the whole unit, as usual. 
 • Determine the model with the highest Discipline value in any other friendly, non-Shaken unit within 8". 
 • Set the Discipline value of the model chosen in step 1 above to the value determined in step 2.

sharedRules.name: Pack Hunter
sharedRules.description:
Units entirely with Pack Hunter must reroll failed Charge Range rolls if either or both of the following apply: 
 • Its Charge is part of a Combined Charge. 
 • Its Charge is Declared towards a unit that is already Engaged in Combat.

sharedRules.description: Enemy units do not gain any Combat Score bonus for fighting in the Flanks or the Rear of this model, and it can never be \surrounded{}. \newline{} In addition, the model cannot benefit from Cover.

sharedRules.name: Path of Destruction
sharedRules.description:
The model part can allocate its Stomp Attack onto Health Pools of Height 4 or less (rather than 0-1). 
 If the model part’s Stomp Attack is allocated towards a Health Pool with Height (3–4), the total number of its hits is halved, rounding fractions up.
